title: Reaching 'three hollows rested' and walking to the Hollow Throne lets you end the entire game on the next action, with zero warning that doing so permanently abandons every other open thread (four companion/faction quests were still active when I won).
where: The Hollow Throne, 'speak the Great Rite over the seat'
